learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn about the amazing green plants around us, their different sizes, and the parts that help them grow!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Some plants are very tall and strong with thick trunks, like Mango trees. Others are small, soft, and bushy, like the beautiful rose plant in a garden!
Just like we have arms and legs, plants have different parts too! Roots hide under the soil, stems stand tall, and leaves catch the sunny light.
Leaves are the kitchen of the plant where food is made. They come in many different shapes, sizes, colors, and even have lovely smells!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Leaf Rubbing Art!
fun_activity.instructions: Collect a dry leaf from the ground. Put it under a white paper and gently rub a green crayon over it to see its magic pattern appear!

quick_recap: ⭐ Plants can be very tall like trees, or very small like grass.
⭐ A plant has roots, a stem, leaves, and beautiful flowers.
⭐ Leaves come in many amazing shapes and help make food for the plant.
